WITH RECURSIVE
Aaron AS (
  SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Aaron Lennon' LIMIT 1
),
Matches AS (
  SELECT m.id, m.goal
  FROM Match m, Aaron
  WHERE Aaron.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11)
  AND m.goal IS NOT NULL
),
SplitGoals AS (
  SELECT id, 
         CASE WHEN INSTR(goal, '</goal>') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(goal, 1, INSTR(goal, '</goal>') - 1) ELSE goal END AS goal_part,
         CASE WHEN INSTR(goal, '</goal>') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(goal, INSTR(goal, '</goal>') + 7) ELSE '' END AS remaining
  FROM Matches
  UNION ALL
  SELECT id,
         CASE WHEN INSTR(remaining, '</goal>') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(remaining, 1, INSTR(remaining, '</goal>') - 1) ELSE remaining END,
         CASE WHEN INSTR(remaining, '</goal>') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(remaining, INSTR(remaining, '</goal>') + 7) ELSE '' END
  FROM SplitGoals
  WHERE remaining != ''
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM SplitGoals, Aaron

WITH RECURSIVE
  split_goals(match_id, rest) AS (
    SELECT id, goal
    FROM Match
    WHERE goal IS NOT NULL AND goal LIKE '%<player1>%'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id,
           substr(rest, instr(rest, '</player1>') + 11)
    FROM split_goals
    WHERE instr(rest, '<player1>') > 0
  ),
  player_goals AS (
    SELECT match_id,
           CAST(
             substr(
               rest,
               instr(rest, '<player1>') + 9,
               instr(rest, '</player1>') - (instr(rest, '<player1>') + 9)
             ) AS INTEGER
           ) AS player_api_id
    FROM split_goals
    WHERE instr(rest, '<player1>') > 0
  )

WITH counts AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(Admission, '-', '')) LIKE '%inpatient%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_male,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(REPLACE(Admission, '-', '')) LIKE '%outpatient%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_male
  FROM Patient
  WHERE LOWER(SEX) IN ('m', 'male')
)
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN inpatient_male > outpatient_male THEN 'inpatient' ELSE 'outpatient' END AS more_male,
  inpatient_male,
  outpatient_male,
  ROUND(100.0 * ABS(inpatient_male - outpatient_male) / NULLIF(inpatient_male + outpatient_male, 0), 2) AS deviation_percentage
FROM counts;

WITH yearly AS (

         SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption

  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  GROUP BY c.Segment, substr(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS Cons2013
  FROM yearly
  GROUP BY Segment
),
increases AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         (Cons2013 - Cons2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(Cons2012, 0) AS PctIncrease
  FROM pivoted
)
SELECT Segment, PctIncrease
FROM increases
